2024_general.fact: November 5, 2024 section: 'UNOFFICIAL VOTING TOTALS (PDF)' (DocumentCenter 1095) is a scanned 'Cumulative Results Report ECTOR COUNTY, TEXAS ... ENR 11.05.2024 Run Time 12:22 AM ... Run Date 11/06/2024', county totals by vote type (Trump Election Day 9,074), scan CreationDate Nov 6 05:38 UTC. 'PRECINCT BY PRECINCT RESULTS (PDF)' (1093): 'Precinct Results Report ... Run Time 1:00 PM ... Run Date 11/13/2024', PDF CreationDate Nov 13 2024. So election-night output was county totals; precinct numbers came a week later. DocumentCenter Last-Modified equals the request time (no upload evidence). Check 3: wayback folder exists but the 2024 CDX query timed out and lists no captures.

2026_primary.fact: March 3, 2026 section lists only 'Official results for the joint primary election (PDF)' (836): 'Cumulative Results Report Ector County, Texas Official Results ... Polling Places Reporting 27 of 27 ... Run Time 9:04 AM ... Run Date 03/10/2026', county totals only, plus reconciliation and hand count files. No per-precinct results posted. Wayback CDX for the night returned no captures.

2026_runoff.fact: May 26, 2026 section lists 'CUMULATIVE FINAL RESULTS REPUBLICAN PARTY (PDF)' (2378) and Democratic (2379): 'Ector County, Texas Joint Primary Runoff Election ... Precincts Reporting 41 of 41', county totals by vote type only (Cornyn Election Day 452), scan CreationDate Jun 3 2026. No per-precinct results posted. Wayback CDX for the night returned no captures.

rationale: All three elections show only county totals on or after election night (2024 precinct report printed Nov 13; 2026 no precinct results at all), so LATER x3 gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. Low because DocumentCenter gives no upload times.
